title: Membership of encoded strings
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $v$, the Boolean oracle that tests membership in the language of encodings $�$ returns true on the pairing of the length-$n$ string of ones with the bit string of $v$ exactly when $v=2n$.
caveat: The language is defined as the set of encodings of a string of $n$ ones paired with the bit representation of $2n$. To state this self-containedly, this uses the language's defining construction, whose given informal description is missing.
